notes: Gerald the Giraffe is the iconic named character — a generic Boardmaker giraffe will not be recognisable enough; source a character-accurate PNG. Core emotional vocabulary (sad, happy, laugh) is central to the story arc as Gerald is mocked before finding his own rhythm. 'Try' captures the key moral message of the book and is highly functional for SPED communication. 'Spin' represents Gerald's unique dancing movement. The cricket character is a small insect who plays the violin-like music — ensure insect image is used, not the sport. 'Jungle' and 'moon' are key setting words already in the activity_images library and should be reused.
